data.title: 萝丝 · 旅舍长椅上的最后一针
data.description: 山路旅舍的长椅晒得发暖。萝丝把破损斗篷的两片布掖在膝上，裹着绷带的手拽过最后一道线，接缝在阳光中收紧。旧皮胸甲上还有尘土，亚麻衫的袖口被风吹得轻轻动。
data.action: 坐着用针线合拢斗篷裂口
data.lighting: 门廊柱影斜落到膝上，露出被阳光照亮的细线
data.promptProse: On an inn porch, Rose gathers the torn edge of her charcoal cloak against her knee and draws a final stitch tight. Cloth wraps cover her hands, and trail dust lingers on the leather cuirass over her linen tunic. Afternoon light crosses the bench and picks out the loose end of the thread.
data.animaCaption: Her wrapped fingers pull the thread taut against the worn cloth before she knots it.
